summary: Conversational form pioneer — high completion rates, but AI-generated interactive forms are eroding its price premium.
moat: Typeform's moat is brand recognition and enterprise compliance: Fortune 500 marketing teams trust its SOC2 compliance, CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce), and signature one-question-at-a-time design that reliably delivers higher response completion rates. The vulnerability is structural: multi-step forms are one of the most frequently vibe-coded UI patterns, and AI can now dynamically generate personalized survey questions in real time.

challengers.name: Tally, Fillout, and dynamic AI form builders
challengers.evidence: Tally reached over 200,000 creators with a Notion-style form builder offering 95% of Typeform's functionality for free, creating massive downward pricing pressure.
